payload.posture: Read Ephesians 2:11–22 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states foreignness becomes citizenship and household membership as apostles, prophets, cornerstone, building, and dwelling join. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
